frozen_original_measurement: Original one UTC-hour representative, adjacent GPS intervals 0.5–2h, solar daypart same across step, plausible speed at most 60 km/h, at least three DAY and NIGHT step observations per original tagged solar day, >=10 qualified days per tag-year and >=5 eligible tags per registered native; never modify old estimands.
ranking_rule: Continue identical original source-metadata SHA256 order for single-native ranks 25–40 (1 based); no title, animal name, q sign, geography, new provider file metadata, effect size or per-event GPS is allowed to affect inclusion/order.
human_privacy_rule: Any Homo sapiens selected is a hard privacy hold for all subsequent provider file and GPS requests; preserve source slot, do not replace.
first_selection_stage_exposure: The wave3 quota 16 was selected AFTER examining wave1 and wave2 outcomes; source identities are nevertheless chosen by the old metadata-only SHA ranking, with no wave3 provider file or GPS event access.
nonresponse_rule: Do not substitute or drop source slots for missing/ambiguous, restricted, over-200MB, schema-incompatible, rare-tag or source-native-incomplete GPS; document all holds, no zero imputation.
inference_boundary: Metadata-priority source study ID sampling; not global wildlife probability sampling or new biological replication, not source-effect confirmation. Human privacy and managed/domestic source domain require independent source-only adjudication before any later GPS analysis.
